instrument: Proposed ordinance using data center tax revenue to cut the car tax rate
summary: Board of Supervisors deferred a second time a vote on using data center tax revenue to reduce the county car tax rate, to Nov 18. The county expects revenue from nine projects, several delayed by a Dominion capacity shortfall.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Weekly Briefing, Sept 21-24, 2026 (digest), citing local reporting (12 On Your Side)

next.event: Chesterfield County vote on data center revenue car-tax ordinance
